name: text.table
doc:
Text tables: columns padded to the widest cell (display width: wide
East Asian characters and emoji count as 2, combining marks as 0),
per-column alignment, and several styles: Plain (space separated, like
Go's tabwriter), ASCII and Unicode boxes, and Markdown. Cells may hold
several lines.

items.name: Plain
items.doc: Style: columns separated by spaces, no borders.
items.summary: Style: columns separated by spaces, no borders.

items.name: Unicode
items.doc: Style: borders drawn with box-drawing characters.
items.summary: Style: borders drawn with box-drawing characters.

items.name: Format
items.doc: Formats rows (the first one is the header) in a style.
items.summary: Formats rows (the first one is the header) in a style.

items.name: New
items.doc: New returns a table with headers.
items.summary: New returns a table with headers.

items.name: RuneWidth
items.doc: RuneWidth returns the display width of r in columns (0 for control and combining characters, 2 for wide ones).
items.summary: RuneWidth returns the display width of r in columns (0 for control and combining characters, 2 for wide ones).

items.name: Width
items.doc:
The display width of s in a terminal: 2 for wide East Asian characters
and emoji, 0 for combining marks and zero-width characters, 1 otherwise.
items.summary: The display width of s in a terminal: 2 for wide East Asian characters and emoji, 0 for combining marks and zero-width characters, 1 otherwise.

items.name: Table
items.doc: Table renders rows of text as aligned columns (Plain, ASCII, Unicode or Markdown style).
items.summary: Table renders rows of text as aligned columns (Plain, ASCII, Unicode or Markdown style).

members.name: Align
members.doc: per column: Left (default), Right or Center
members.summary: per column: Left (default), Right or Center

members.name: Padding
members.doc: spaces between columns in Plain style, inside borders otherwise
members.summary: spaces between columns in Plain style, inside borders otherwise

members.name: AddRow
members.doc: AddRow appends a row of cells.
members.summary: AddRow appends a row of cells.

members.name: SetAlign
members.doc: SetAlign sets the alignment of column col: Left, Right or Center.
members.summary: SetAlign sets the alignment of column col: Left, Right or Center.

members.name: NumRows
members.doc: NumRows returns the number of rows (without the header).
members.summary: NumRows returns the number of rows (without the header).
